title: Formal vs Informal English: 5 Words You Need #shorts
description:
Formal vs informal English: five everyday words and their formal versions.
• buy → purchase
• help → assist
• tell → inform
• need → require
• end → conclude

Use formal words in work emails and essays.

Which formal word is new to you? Write it in the comments.
